About Me

Passionate Designer Who Brings
Digital Visions to Life

I'm Sushil Shukla, a passionate Web & Graphic Designer dedicated to crafting visually stunning and functionally robust websites. With a keen eye for detail and a commitment to excellence, I blend art and technology to deliver exceptional results.

My journey began with a love for both art and technology, which led me to Visual Media Academy and then Punjab University. What started as curiosity has grown into a professional expertise spanning WordPress development, WooCommerce, Webflow, and UI design.

Currently working as a Junior WordPress Developer at Requisite Technologies Pvt Ltd, Mohali, where I'm actively involved in both design and development — building responsive, modern websites and sharpening my front-end skills every day.
